# What the data-dict export loses: Crimes - 2001 to Present (City of Chicago)

The YAML files here follow data-dict spec 0.1.0. They describe the common data format, so they validate against its parquet files. The records in `metadata/` remain canonical. This table counts what the export drops or flattens into text.

| | `20261119` |
|---|---|
| variables exported | 27 |
| variables listed by name only (no type the records can support) | 22 |
| quantities exported with open range bounds (no valid range recorded) | 4 |
| availability entries (wave by form, with n), summarized as one line of text | 546 |
| field origins (publisher, data file, rule, hand, model) not exported | 102 |
| release id not expressible as data-dict `version` (needs semver or a date) | 1 |
